agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse.engine.grouping.group_functions(): replaced the boolean has_as flag (which disabled CREATE TABLE column-list protection for the whole statement whenever any 'AS' keyword appeared anywhere) with tracking the index of the first 'AS' keyword, so only Name+Parenthesis pairs before that index (the actual CREATE TABLE column-definition list) are skipped from function-grouping, while function calls at/after AS (e.g. inside CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT func() ...) are still grouped as sql.Function as intended. Verified with ad-hoc scripts covering plain functions, SELECT functions, COUNT(*), CREATE TABLE with/without AS, CTAS with and without column lists, nested DEFAULT function calls, OVER clauses, function aliasing, and case-insensitive keywords.
